title: 木枠のインセクトホテル
description: 公園や公共菜園の展示シーンに置く、支柱付きの木枠インセクトホテル。背板と切妻屋根、4区画の棚、実際に中空の葦管と木管、横・縦の隙間を持つ板組を造形しています。昆虫・植栽・地面は含まず、生息環境の適性、防虫、保全効果を保証しない静的な外観模型です。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.147 × 1.853 × 0.494 m、12,560三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A freestanding timber insect hotel for park and community-garden scenes, with a boarded back, gabled canopy, four shelf compartments, genuinely hollow reed and timber sleeves, and horizontal/vertical slatted refuges. No insects, planting or ground are included. This static appearance prop makes no habitat suitability, pest-control or conservation-performance claim. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.147 × 1.853 × 0.494 m; 12,560 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
